name: you-web
description: Use You.com web search for tasks that need current information, external facts, source reading, or cited answers. Provides a search -> read -> cite pipeline: 'you-search' finds candidate web pages, 'you-contents' extracts full page content, and answers are built from read sources with inline citations. Use when the agent needs up-to-date docs, factual verification, or research beyond its training data. Works with the You.com MCP server (https://api.you.com/mcp, authenticated via YDC_API_KEY) or the keyless profile (https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free) for basic search.
author: youdotcom-oss
